mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 81 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. Tonight features a Waxing Gibbous moon and a clear view of the ISS starting at 9:37 PM, rising over Cross Plains toward Oregon and reaching halfway up the sky. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 71, with no rain expected.

The Verona City Clerk office has closed submissions for the I Voted sticker contest, where students grades K through 12 have been submitting designs for the November election. The community will have their say with public voting running from July 28 through August 7, with four category winners having their art printed on official election stickers.

There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27, followed by trivia nights early next week at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Macs.
In our weekly police report, we look back to July 13, when officers responded to a passerby report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock. The 36-year-old driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I.
Indulge in today's delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor. The shop is open until 10:30 PM, so you still have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
